senses.definition: an image, sound, or message designed to influence someone without their awareness

examples.vi: Một số người nghe các bản ghi tiềm thức nhằm tăng sự tự tin trong lúc ngủ.

senses.vi: thông điệp tiềm thức; bản ghi âm tiềm thức

wiktionary.gloss: An advertisement, a message, etc., which is conveyed in a manner that a person is unaware of being influenced by it.

examples: She spent all night listening to a subliminal to change her eye color.
wiktionary.gloss: An audio or video recording, often consisting of ambient music or white noise with hidden affirmations, intended to produce physical or psychological changes in the listener through repetition.
Chiefly preceded by the: the subconscious (dated) or unconscious self.

blocks.etymology: Ancient Greek τεχνολογία (tekhnología)lbor. Learned borrowing from Ancient Greek τεχνολογία (tekhnología, “systematic treatment (of grammar)”), from τέχνη (tékhnē, “art”) + -λογία (-logía, “study”). By surface analysis, techno- + -logy.

senses.definition: scientific knowledge used in practical ways, or the modern machines and devices created from it

examples.en: Modern technology allows people to work from home.
examples.vi: Công nghệ hiện đại cho phép mọi người làm việc tại nhà.

examples.en: The company develops new mobile technologies.
examples.vi: Công ty phát triển các công nghệ di động mới.

thesaurus.definition: the application of the knowledge and usage of tools (such as machines or utensils) and techniques to control one's environment
the discipline dealing with the art or science of applying scientific knowledge to practical problems
machinery and equipment developed from engineering or other applied sciences

examples: Meronyms: (contextually meronymous) art, applied science, industrial arts
Humankind relies on technology to keep average standard of living higher than it would otherwise be.
wiktionary.gloss: The combined application of science and art in practical ways in industry, as for example in designing new machines.

examples: We went to the trade show to see the latest technology on display.
wiktionary.gloss: Machines or equipment thus designed.

examples: the incipient metalworking technology of the Bronze Age
wiktionary.gloss: Any useful skill or mechanism that humans have developed or invented (including in prescientific eras).
Any useful trait that has evolved in any organism.
The study of or a collection of techniques.

tatoeba.en: Why didn't modern technology develop in China?
tatoeba.vi: Tại sao công nghệ hiện đại lại không phát triển ở Trung Quốc?

tatoeba.en: With advances in technology over the decades, robotic floor cleaners one day might be able to write coherent sentences.
tatoeba.vi: Với sự phát triển của công nghệ trong những thập niên tới, rất có thể robot lau nhà sẽ có thể viết được những câu mạch lạc.

blocks.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *n̥- Ancient Greek ᾰ̓- (ă-)

thesaurus.definition: a compound made up of a ring of four carbon atoms and one sulfur atom and one nitrogen atom

wiktionary.gloss: A six-membered heterocycle containing four carbon atoms, one nitrogen and one sulfur atom, and two double bonds.

blocks.etymology: From Middle English toucher, equivalent to touch + -er. Sense 3 is derived from the sense of touching someone for money.

thesaurus.definition: a person who causes or allows a part of the body to come in contact with someone or something

wiktionary.gloss: One who touches.
A ball lying in contact with the jack.
A toucha; one who tries to get something out of others for nothing in return.

blocks.etymology: From trash + -man.

wiktionary.gloss: A worker who collects and hauls away household or municipal garbage, often using a truck to transport it for processing or disposal.

blocks.etymology: From trideca- + -gon.

wiktionary.gloss: A polygon having thirteen sides and thirteen angles.

blocks.etymology: From two + edged.

wiktionary.gloss: having two cutting edges
having two, often contrasting, meanings or interpretations
Referring to a mineral's characteristic crystal shape or form due to formation from a gel.

blocks.etymology: From un- + bred.

wiktionary.gloss: Untaught or untrained.

blocks.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *dʰeh₁-? Proto-Indo-European *(H)n̥dʰí

wiktionary.gloss: Having insufficient power for its operation.

examples: Wizards are underpowered even though they start off with two magic spells.
wiktionary.gloss: Not powerful enough.

blocks.etymology: From un- (prefix meaning ‘not’) + fathom (“to measure the depth of (water); (figurative) to deeply understand (someone or something)”) + -able (suffix forming adjectives denoting things not able or fit to be done).

senses.definition: too strange, deep, or complicated to be fully understood

examples.en: For some unfathomable reason, she decided to leave her dream job.
examples.vi: Vì một lý do không thể hiểu nổi, cô ấy quyết định bỏ công việc mơ ước của mình.

senses.definition: too deep to be measured, especially of water or darkness

examples.en: The ship sank into the unfathomable depths of the ocean.
examples.vi: Con tàu chìm vào những tầng sâu không đáy của đại dương.

thesaurus.definition: resembling an abyss in depth; so deep as to be unmeasurable

vi_block: Khó dò, không dò được (vực sâu, sông sâu... ).
Không dò ra, không hiểu thấu (điều bí mật... ).

wiktionary.gloss: Especially of depth: physically incapable of being measured; immeasurable.

examples: The sheer number of warriors the enemy attacked with was unfathomable.
wiktionary.gloss: Impossible to grasp the extent of, or to fully know or understand.

blocks.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *n̥- From un- + orthodox.

senses.definition: different from what is usual, traditional, or widely accepted

examples.en: He had an unorthodox method of solving mathematical problems.
examples.vi: Anh ấy có một phương pháp khác thường để giải các bài toán.

thesaurus.definition: independent in behavior or thought

wiktionary.gloss: Unusual, unconventional, or idiosyncratic.
One who accomplishes great deeds but receives little or no recognition for them.

blocks.etymology: From vagin- + -itis.

thesaurus.definition: inflammation of the vagina (usually associated with candidiasis)

wiktionary.gloss: Inflammation of the vagina.
